recentItems.title: ACA Allertor-125 Siren Test @ Batavia, Ohio
recentItems.description:
Siren Brand: Alerting Communicators of America (ACA)
Model: Allertor-125
Location: Batavia, Ohio
Test Time: First Wednesday at Noon
Test Signal: Full Alert
Camera Used: Canon VIXIA HF R800
Others Present: None

For a first Wednesday, my wife and a friend of ours went to Batavia to record the only Allertor in the State of Ohio. This worked out perfectly because it was my wife's birthday that day and I wanted to take her to this siren. Sure enough, right at noon, the tones dropped and the siren came to life.

DISCLAIMER: There are activation tones present in this video. DO NOT USE THEM OVER THE AIR... I am not responsible for your negligence and stupidity if you get caught.

recentItems.title: Sterling Model M 6 PM Blast @ Seven Mile, Ohio
recentItems.description:
Siren Brand: Sterling Sirens
Model: Model M
Location: Seven Mile, Ohio
Test Time: Everyday at 6 PM
Test Signal: Short Blast
Camera Used: Canon VIXIA HF R800
Others Present: None

After railfanning in Carlisle, my wife and I went over to Seven Mile where there was a Model M that does evening blasts. Of course as soon as I was finishing setting up, the siren goes off 3 minutes early. The good news is that I do have plans to return to Seven Mile and rerecord the 6 PM blast hopefully get setup earlier this time.

recentItems.title: Federal Signal 2001-SRN Siren Test @ Bradford, Ohio
recentItems.description:
Siren Brand: Federal Signal
Model: 2001-SRN (4th Gen)
Location: Bradford, Ohio (Part of Darke County Siren System)
Test Time: First Monday of the Month at Noon
Test Signal: Full Alert
Camera Used: Canon VIXIA HF R800
Others Present: None

It's factory painted yellow. This is the first time that I've ever seen a yellow 2001-SRN in person before. I know this siren was last recorded in 2018 and this one was on my bucket list for a long time. So we got up very early and ventured out to Darke County from Akron to record it and boy she is healthy.

recentItems.title: Federal Signal 508-128 Siren Test @ Hartford, Ohio
recentItems.description:
Siren Brand: Federal Signal
Model: 508-128
Location: Hartford Township, Ohio (Part of Trumbull County Siren System)
Test Time: First Saturday of the Month at Noon
Test Signal: Full Alert
Camera Used: Canon VIXIA HF R800
Others Present: None

On a decent Saturday, my wife and I took a little adventure out to Trumbull County for a siren test and we chose Hartford. It's been a little while since we recorded a 508 and this one was very easy to access. The county was 2 minutes late but it still went off and I think this siren has a sight low pitch to it as it was sounding.

**WARNING** There are activation tones present in this video. Please DO NOT transmit these tones over the air. I'm not held responsible for your negligence if you get caught doing that... DON'T DO IT!!
